data.subject: finance back-office workflows at Zipline
data.body:
Hi Sendil,

You became Chief Financial Officer at Zipline in July 2026. Having previously led finance at Tesla, entering the role usually involves reviewing existing finance systems and back-office workflows to evaluate operational efficiency. Uber Freight cut invoice audit time from 1 day to 1 hour with Zamp's AI agents.

Are you open to a 20-minute call to discuss this?

[Your name]
